items.title: 'Sense of betrayal': The peaceful Nordic country preparing for war
items.description: Denmark is fast-tracking female conscription as it muscles up to Russia and faces threats of invasion from the US.

items.title: Prince William's 'calm state' comment about Andrew could signal a striking shift
items.description: When Prince William and Princess Catherine stepped out for their first public appearance since Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's arrest, an innocuous question was levelled at them. The candid response was perhaps more revealing than anticipated.

items.title: How unprecedented terror charges expose WA's social cohesion issues
items.description: The charging of two young West Australian men with terror offences show the challenges facing social cohesion, and solving the problem is not going to be easy.

items.title: Terror police investigate disturbance, white powder at Perth Mosque
items.description: Terrorism police in Perth investigate a disturbance outside a Perth mosque overnight and the discovery of a "non-suspicious substance" on the footpath outside.

items.title: Pride in Protest float excluded from Mardi Gras over 'offensive' posts
items.description: Mardi Gras organisers have issued a formal warning to Pride in Protest on Friday morning, stating they had breached the parade's terms and conditions.

items.title: This is what 84 cameras reveal about survival and sacrifice at Bondi
items.description: As gunshots rang out at Bondi, dozens of eyewitnesses risked their lives to film the horror. This is what they wanted you to see.

items.title: Former Play School host Lorraine Bayly dies, aged 89
items.description: Lorraine Bayly, star of long-running soap opera The Sullivans and a former Play School host, has died aged 89, after years of ill health.

items.title: First Aboriginal woman to receive PhD at Harvard remembered as 'trailblazer'
items.description: MaryAnn Bin-Sallik was the first Aboriginal nurse graduate in Darwin and the first Aboriginal person to receive a PhD at Harvard University. Following her death at age 85, the Djaru Elder is being remembered for her work in Indigenous education, health and human rights.

items.title: Breaking: Triple Melbourne Cup-winning legend Makybe Diva dies from sudden illness
items.description: The champion racehorse who rose to fame after combining with Glen Boss for three-straight Melbourne Cup wins has died.

items.title: NASA revamps Artemis Moon landing program
items.description: NASA shakes up its Artemis Moon exploration program, adding an extra practice flight before a crewed lunar landing planned for two years' time.

items.title: In coal country this battery didn't stand a chance
items.description: A community battery project three years in the making, run by a local not-for-profit and backed by the council, was killed after a spark of misinformation about its fire risk was ignited.

items.title: Libs 'not concerned' by One Nation challenge in Nepean by-election
items.description: The Liberal Party launches the campaign for candidate Anthony Marsh in the Nepean by-election, following the departure of Sam Groth.

items.title: Clinton tells Congress he had 'no inkling' of Epstein's crimes
items.description: The former US president is being questioned by the House Oversight Committee, which is looking into the US government's handling of the Epstein case.

items.title: Once-in-a-generation deluge for SA and Vic as north eyes triple cyclone threat
items.description: Populated regions stretching from Eyre Peninsula to western Victoria and the Murray River are at risk of dangerous flash flooding, amid growing signs three additional tropical lows will form off Australia's northern coast next week.

items.title: Can the most exploitative reality TV show actually be held accountable?
items.description: America's Next Top Model has aged terribly. What does accountability even mean for an era of unprecedented exploitation on screen?

items.title: Pakistan and the Taliban edge closer to 'open war' — but neither can win
items.description: Pakistan's declaration of an "open war" with the Afghan Taliban sounds dangerous, but analysts say neither side has the capacity to win.

items.title: Gorillaz confront grief with Indian music greats on new album
items.description: Damon Albarn and Jamie Hewlett discuss how trips to India, grieving and A-list collaborations shaped the latest genre-defying Gorillaz album, The Mountain.

items.title: What it's like holding a Pride event in a regional Australian town
items.description: How do you celebrate the annual Mardi Gras parade if you live hundreds of kilometres from Sydney? These regional areas are celebrating Pride in their own special way.

items.title: Dozens of US Republicans call for tariff probe into Australian lamb
items.description: Republicans write to Donald Trump's top trade officials to request an investigation into Australian lamb, as several members of Congress sponsor a bill for a 30 per cent tariff on Australian sheep products.

items.title: Trump says of Iran 'sometimes you have to' use force as US-Tehran tensions rise
items.description: The US has amassed a huge military presence in the region after the president threatened military action if Tehran refused to forswear nuclear weapons.

items.title: V'landys confirms NRL's three-year, four-city global expansion plan
items.description: After experiencing tremendous success in Las Vegas, Peter V'landys is planning to take the NRL to other major cities around the world.

items.title: FIFO footballers keep clubs in mining communities alive
items.description: Local football leagues depend on FIFO workers to boost player numbers in remote and regional WA, and the workers say getting involved makes being away from home a little more enjoyable.

items.title: Tiny Victorian keepsake provides a snapshot of a bygone era
items.description: While wealthy upper-class colonial families were sitting for expensive studio portraits in the 1880s, many with less money were collecting miniature portraits in tiny photo albums like this one.

items.title: What the Warner Bros deal could mean for streaming and movie theatres
items.description: The proposed takeover of Warner Bros by Paramount could reshape Hollywood, movie theatres and the wider media landscape.

items.title: Quick and easy green ginger and miso noodles made from pantry staples
items.description: Close the delivery app and get through some kitchen staples with this easy spinach, ginger and miso noodle recipe.
